notes.title: Sale Issues Announcement.
notes.notes:
Sale Issues Announcement.
Recently, the steam sale has been experiencing a large number of refunds and re-purchases, and we've realised today that these issues have had a profound impact on the normal operation of the game.
We have realised today that these issues have had a profound impact on the game's ability to function properly, and we have received over 200 refunds so far in June.
As of June this year, we have received over 200 refunds, and a large number of these purchases were made after the update was released.
The refunds were issued after the downloads were completed and the normal updates were completed, leaving us short of the expected steam transfers for the month of June.
We have not been able to earn steam revenue for the first month of June, which has made it difficult for us to operate and pay our staff.
Here, this group to express the condemnation of this behaviour and helpless, I hope that all the so-called "self-purchase" reproduced friends.
At least support our normal operation, you can also normal "reproduced" is not it?

The group since the opening of the catalyst has been plagued by piracy, which is the norm in the industry, the group did not take it seriously, but now, the piracy and piracy of the world's most popular games.
But now, the piracy and the abnormal modifications have seriously affected our normal production and development, and we are using daz3d's software.
While we use daz3d's resources and techniques for rendering, our packages are also being reverse cracked and released, and daz3d is also being used commercially for rendering.
And the commercial use of daz3d is also a very costly and time-consuming thing, we in order to achieve some effects in daz, the
We have invested a lot of time and money to implement some effects in daz, which is like a bottomless pit for a small production team like us.
A lot of people have suggested to us that we should use ai to draw, or games to create rendered content, but we think this is not good for the players.
We believe that this is not responsible for the players, the game is essentially another kind of handicraft, if we can not maintain its production.
If you can't maintain its production attributes, to the game, to the ai, that's sorry for the players to our investment and expenditure.

At the same time, I hope that all friends can be generous, do not take us as a bloodsucker endless draw, the production team is a very small amount of the game, but also a very small amount of the game, but also a very small amount of the game, but also a very small amount of the game.
We are a very small group of people, and it's hard for us to make it on our own.
We want to make as good a game as we can.
We hope that we can make a good game to the best of our ability, so that we can live up to the expectations of the players who have invested their time and money in this project.
We also hope that you will be kind to us and let us work together for the better.

notes.title: Quarterly Release Updates.
notes.notes:
Subsequent Updates Planned Changes.
Starting after this update (28 July 2023), the
The group will change the update cycle to quarterly updates.
That's once every 3 months.
The main purpose of this change is to let you experience the content better.
The monthly updates are not enough to satisfy your playing experience.
We have received a lot of suggestions from players.
We have received a lot of suggestions from players, so we plan to change it to once a quarter.

ps: Answers to some questions
Q:Will you run away with quarterly updates?
A: Quarterly updates will not affect our update plan, we have an internal test plan.
We have an internal test project, because we need to fix bugs and content on a monthly basis, so the internal test project is updated on a monthly basis.
If you have any questions about the update or want to check the progress of the update, you can visit our qq group, or send us an email.
or send an email, thank you for your support!

Q:What is the beta programme? Do I need to pay for it?
A:Yes, there is an additional fee for the beta programme, which we have started.
The main purpose of the beta programme is to update our content and support our survival.
And the support of the beta programme will help us to maintain our confidence in the development of the game.
If you would like to participate in the beta programme, you can visit our Love Power page.
We would like to thank you for your support!

notes.notes:

各位购买游戏的用户们、合作朋友们：
2023年农历春节即将到来，我工作室全体员工感谢您一直以来对我们的大力支持和信赖，
